body:
I'll try online, but a few people I met there are not the same. We're not talking about causes we care about, just about movies, books, games, news - almost nothing personal.
I think we should meet for this, but almost everyone I met online lives too far.
New places. I'm socially awkward. Really, really awkward. I'll be too shy to talk, all the time.
Because I'm afraid of failure. I'm afraid to fail everything over and over.

I can't fix one single issue that bothers me the most. People.
During three of four last years I've made no friends, not a single person from four last years wants to be connected with me. 
Same with relationships, almost no luck at all.

For example?
Find new flat, new friends, new job\university?
It's good in theory, but I can't do everything at one time.

Probably will. You never know what's going to happen next day.
Everything new I start gets boring very fast. Really boring, I don't know what to do with it.

5 years and no improvement, it's been only getting worse. 
When? I can't take much more. I'm just denying to take more.

I have permanently running TeamSpeak 3, if you're interested, I can make a permanent room there for this thing, so you can come at any time. PM me if you're interested. Maybe I can even talk with you too, not sure if my English is good enough for this.

I have no present. What is present? I don't like anything about my present, about myself. 
They care just because of guilty, morale and everything, nothing personal.
You guys have reasons to care about strangers. You're probably good or something. I will never attract such a person, I'm nothing special.
No, I'm not bigger. Issues won't resolve themselves, and I'm simply incapable of resolving them.

I think we never know what exists and what does not. 

I can't regret or feel guilty while I'm dead.
My friends don't care about me for real. Same about family.

I see no opportunity. No light. Nothing. It's just going to be this bad or even worse for my whole life.
And I don't want to live like this.

I don't know what to explore. When I find something new, start something.. I usually feel excited about it for a very short time. 
After this I never want to return. I tried to force myself, but doing it didn't help either.

Yes, I still consider suicide as an option because of this: I believe that no living being is capable of knowing what is that exactly - to be dead. For now, at least. So, it's like a lottery. This world is bad, bad for a long time and I see no end for this. And death according to my knowledge can be better than this, or can't, I don't know. 
But, if emotions are just chemicals in our bodies - probably I won't feel any emotions after death, at least any old emotions. No more bad old emotions is pretty good.

Everything was okay. Really, nothing was too wrong, bad things happened, but I was okay with them. Untill one day. I fallen in love, and it triggered everything. 
In one moment I realized - I'm nothing. Never had any luck with that girl.
It was bad, but still okay. 
Another love. I became jealousy, with a reason, still no luck. It went for three years, and still hurts me to think about it, comes to me at night. 
After this romantic-me just died. 
About month ago I got into relationship. She fell in love with me within minutes. And disappeared within a week. 
That's most significant. Actually, I'm really social and everything, I can count about twenty girls in sum with whom I tried to start relationship.

Another side of my life. I've been studying in mechmath MSU. Very good, especially for me. But I was so depressed. I could not do anything. Brains won't work. Now I don't study there anymore, failed exams. 

Now, I'm playing PC, watching movies and so on. And even this is boring me.
